title: GQL Descriptors Schema
description: JSON Schema for GQL descriptor hierarchy based on ISO/IEC 39075 GQL standard

namedSubobjects.description: Set of named subobjects that comprises (identifier, object descriptor) pairs

owner.description: The owner of the GQL-schema, an authorization identifier of a principal

namedSubobjects.description: Set of named subobjects of the GQL-schema

constrainingGraphType.description: Optional constraining graph type that is a globally resolved reference to a graph type schema object

constraintDictionary.description: A constraint dictionary, which is a set comprising zero or more uniquely named constraint descriptors

declaredName.description: The declared name of the primary base type of all graph types

preferredName.description: The preferred name of graph types

nodeTypeDescriptors.description: The set of node type descriptors (also known as a node type set)

edgeTypeDescriptors.description: The set of edge type descriptors (also known as an edge type set)

nodeTypeKeyLabelSetDictionary.description: Maps node type key label sets to node types contained in the node type set

edgeTypeKeyLabelSetDictionary.description: Maps edge type key label sets to sets of edge types contained in the edge type set

constraintSetDictionary.description: Maps the name of each constraint in the constraint set to that constraint

declaredName.description: The declared name of the primary base type of all node types

preferredName.description: The preferred name of node types

labelSet.description: The set of zero or more labels (also known as a node type label set)

items.description: A label has a name that is an identifier that is unique within the node type label set

propertyTypeSet.description: The set of zero or more property type descriptors (also known as a node type property type set)

declaredName.description: The declared name of the primary base type of all edge types

preferredName.description: The preferred name of edge types

labelSet.description: The set of zero or more labels (also known as an edge type label set)

items.description: A label has a name that is an identifier that is unique within the edge type label set

propertyTypeSet.description: The set of zero or more property type descriptors (also known as an edge type property type set)

isDirected.description: The indication of whether the edge type is directed or undirected

sourceNodeType.description: The source node type descriptor (if directed)

destinationNodeType.description: The destination node type descriptor (if directed)

endpointNodeTypes.description: The set of one or two endpoint node type descriptors (if undirected)
